title: Blue Mountain 66 S Spooky Lane
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:**Please note: This home has a 120-day cancellation policy and additional cancelation fees apply.- Gulf-front- Gated community- Complimentary beach setups each morning include 2 beach chairs with 1 umbrella (Mar 1-Oct 31)- Private heated pool **Pool heating available Oct 1-May 1 for $60 per day**- Complimentary Peloton Bike- an Alaya exclusive amenity- Elevator- 6 Seater Low Speed Vehicle- Stainless steel kitchen appliances- 5 adult bikes provided- Complete Clean Linen Participant - ALL linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkoutDETAILS: Blissful beachside living awaits at 66 Spooky Lane, a Gulf-front paradise set in beautiful Blue Mountain Beach. Tucked within a private community, this 5-bedroom, 7-bathroom luxury property accommodates 12 guests in unmatched comfort. Indulge in days of basking in the sunshine beside the glittering private pool, taking in the shimmering Gulf view from the balconies, or strolling to the white sand beach using the dedicated walkover—directly behind the property.Rolling sand dunes turn the sprawling first-level pool deck into a secluded oasis, sheltered from the beach. Stretch out on the cushioned loungers, cool off with a swim, or unwind in the shade of the oversized umbrella. An outdoor shower and an in-home elevator add the final touches to this floor.On the second level, brilliant Gulf views draw guests into the elegant great room, as shades of taupe and brown, gleaming Travertine tiles, and seagrass elements set the scene for an elevated beach escape. Polished granite countertops and high-end appliances feature in the spacious kitchen, complete with an island and a breakfast bar for 6—a perfect spot for quick bites or hosting a private chef. Savor group dinners at the 10-person dining table before adjourning to the living space, where a 65” TV and soundbar provide top-of-the-line entertainment. On the north side of the home, a balcony overlooking the quiet neighborhood hosts a barbecue grill, while to the south is a furnished, covered deck made for enjoying the endless Gulf view. At bedtime, retire to the primary bedroom, boasting a king bed, private bathroom, and balcony access. There is also a laundry room on this level.The third-level lounge includes a loveseat, TV, kitchenette, and dining table for 4, making it easy for guests to start the morning with a rich cup of coffee before meandering out to balcony seating. There are 2 lavish primary bedrooms featuring king beds, private bathrooms, and access to the balcony, alongside a family-friendly bunk room with a queen bed and twin-over-twin bunk.The fourth-floor guest bedroom offers a private retreat, boasting a king bed and a private Gulf-facing balcony.Experience an indulgent Gulf getaway at 66 Spooky Lane in Blue Mountain Beach. Effortlessly explore with parking for 3 vehicles, as well as 5 complimentary adult bikes. For beach access, follow the walkover off the back deck. Book today!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (Sleeps 12):SECOND FLOOR:- Primary Gulf-Front Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower and Tub SeparateTHIRD FLOOR:- Primary Gulf-Front Bedroom: King Bed, Two Private Bathrooms, One with Shower and Tub Separate, One with Shower Only- Gulf-Front Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower and Tub Separate- Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed and Twin-over-Twin Bunkbed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub ComboFOURTH FLOOR:- Gulf-Front Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower OnlyNEARBY ATTRACTIONS: - Yoga Studio & Gym (Steps Away)- Gulf Place Restaurants and Shopping (Steps Away) - Santa Rosa Country Club and Golf Course and The Vue Restaurant (One Mile) - Longleaf Greenway Western Bike Trail (Steps Away) Weddings are not allowed at this home. If this policy is violated, you may be asked to vacate the property and forfeit any rental payments, as well as be subject to fines.
